definitions.explanation: A condition of infrequent or difficult bowel movements.

examples.japanese: {便秘|べんぴ}に{悩|なや}んでいる。
{便秘|べんぴ}を{解消|かいしょう}するには{食物繊維|しょくもつせんい}が{大切|たいせつ}だ。
examples.english: Fiber is important for relieving constipation.

examples.japanese: {便秘薬|べんぴやく}を{飲|の}んだ。

notes:
{便秘|べんぴ} refers to constipation. It can function as a noun or as a する verb ({便秘|べんぴ}する, to be constipated). This is a useful word to know when visiting a doctor or pharmacy in Japan.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {便秘|べんぴ}になる: to become constipated
- {便秘|べんぴ}する: to be constipated
- {便秘|べんぴ}に{悩|なや}む: to suffer from constipation
- {便秘気味|べんぴぎみ}: tending toward constipation
- {便秘|べんぴ}を{解消|かいしょう}する: to relieve constipation

RELATED TERMS:
- {便秘薬|べんぴやく} / {下剤|げざい}: laxative
- {下痢|げり}: diarrhea (opposite condition)
- お{通|つう}じ: bowel movement (euphemistic, polite)

AT THE DOCTOR:
{便秘|べんぴ}がちです (I tend to get constipated) is a common way to describe chronic symptoms to a doctor.
